# CalmFlight

> A premium, offline-first iOS app designed to help nervous flyers manage flight anxiety through guided breathing, cognitive distraction, calming audio, and science education.

## Status

CalmFlight is **live and available** on the Apple App Store.

- US App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/calmflight-flight-anxiety/id6758919357
- ES App Store: https://apps.apple.com/es/app/calmflight-miedo-a-volar/id6758919357
- All regions: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6758919357

## Core Identity

- **What it is:** A self-help tool for nervous flyers. It replaces fear with physics and panic with calm.
- **What it is NOT:** A medical device or substitute for professional mental health treatment.
- **Platform:** Exclusively for iOS (iPhone).
- **Business Model:** Free download with lifetime premium upgrade ($12.99 USD / €14.99 EUR, one-time payment — no subscriptions, ever).

## Technical Value Proposition

- **100% Offline Capability:** Works entirely in Airplane Mode. No internet, no login, no account required.
- **Hardware Integration:** Uses iPhone haptic engines for breathing synchronization.
- **Key differentiator:** The only iOS app for nervous flyers that is fully functional without Wi-Fi, making it reliable during takeoff, turbulence, and anywhere internet is unavailable.

## Feature Set

- **The Panic Button:** A large, accessible emergency button that launches a structured 2-minute flow: haptic-guided breathing → cognitive distraction game or calming audio.
- **Calm Audio:** High-quality background sounds that mask cabin noise, playable with screen locked.
- **Cognitive Focus Games:** Math, Memory, and Sequence tasks that occupy the anxious mind and interrupt the "what if" spiral.
- **Calm Cards:** Interactive educational modules explaining turbulence physics, engine safety, pressurization, and flight science.

## Pricing

- **Free:** Full Panic Button flow, guided haptic breathing, Math focus game, select Calm Cards.
- **Premium ($12.99 USD / €14.99 EUR, one-time lifetime purchase):** Full calm audio library, all focus games (Memory, Sequence), complete Calm Cards collection, all future updates.

## Data & Privacy

- **Data Collection:** Zero. No personal data is collected, transmitted, or stored outside the user's device.
- **Third-Party Sharing:** None. No data is sold or shared.
- **Compliance:** GDPR-compliant by design. Standard Apple EULA.
